baseline.note: The abstract of the same paper rounds this to "735 km downstream".
baseline.quote: located in Soudan, MN (47.8∘ N latitude, and 92.2∘ W longitude), 735.3 km from the NuMI beam production target

depth.quote: The detector is housed in a specially excavated cavern, 705 m underground (2070 meters-water-equivalent)

magnetic_field.quote: The field strength averaged over the fiducial volume in the near detector 1.28 T, compared to 1.42 T in the far detector.

total_mass.quote: This 5,400 metric ton detector is constructed as two 'supermodules'

description.quote: This 5,400 metric ton detector is constructed as two 'supermodules'
description.value: 486 octagonal steel-scintillator planes arranged in two supermodules

summary.plain: A 5,400-tonne stack of 486 eight-sided steel and plastic plates, magnetised so it could tell neutrinos from antineutrinos, sitting 705 metres underground in an old Minnesota iron mine 735 kilometres from the beam.
summary.technical: 5.4 kt magnetised steel-scintillator tracking calorimeter of 486 octagonal planes in two supermodules, 1.42 T average field, at 705 m depth (2070 m.w.e.) in the Soudan Underground Laboratory, 735.3 km from the NuMI target.

technology.quote: The two detectors are magnetized steel-scintillator tracking calorimeters.
